games.description: A solo anomaly hunt through an eccentric museum. Sark and chat scrutinize exhibits, visitors, and monitors, rebuild their streak after wrong calls, and work through the final stretch.
games.title: Back rooms: The old Watcher

games.description: Sark explores Dreamcore’s five large maps across several solo visits. He escapes the pools, navigates the neighborhood and hotel, works through the playrooms’ generator maze, and tours the dead mall; the playrooms remain unfinished when he leaves them for another visit.
games.title: Dreamcore

games.description: Sark explores a large sequence of liminal environments with fast movement, encounters hostile entities and searches for routes between areas. The final search ends with the game announcing a death from hunger after 194 hours in the Backrooms.

games.description: Sark tests a sprawling Backrooms shooter, then returns in VR to wrestle with interaction controls, ammunition and a giant parrot.
